text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 大家好,欢迎收看《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收看《Real Easy English》。

text: In this podcast, we have real conversations
zh: 在这个播客中,我们进行真实的对话
zh_hant: 在這個播客中,我們進行真實的對話

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语来帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語來幫助你學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Beth.
You can watch a video version of this podcast
zh: 你可以观看这期播客的视频版本
zh_hant: 你可以觀看這期播客的影片版本

text: and find a worksheet to help you learn
zh: 找一份练习题来帮助你学习
zh_hant: 找一份練習題來幫助你學習

text: on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
Hello Beth, how are you today?
zh: 你好,贝丝,你今天怎么样?
zh_hant: 你好,貝絲,你今天怎麼樣?

text: I'm very well, thank you.
How are you?
Yes, I'm fine, thank you.
Today we're talking all about being creative .
zh: 今天我们要聊的话题是创造力。
zh_hant: 今天我們要聊的話題是創造力。

text: If you are a creative person,
zh: 如果你是一个有创造力的人,
zh_hant: 如果你是一個有創造力的人,

text: you enjoy things like art or making things
zh: 你喜欢艺术或做手工之类的事情
zh_hant: 你喜歡藝術或做手工之類的事情

text: and you have lots of ideas.
OK, so let's get started.
Are you a creative person?
zh: 你是一个有创造力的人吗?
zh_hant: 你是一個有創造力的人嗎?

text: Well, we have quite a creative job, don't we?
zh: 我们的工作还挺有创意的,不是吗?
zh_hant: 我們的工作還挺有創意的,不是嗎?

text: are always coming up with ideas for new
series.
Editing videos is quite a creative thing.
zh: 剪辑视频是一件很有创意的事情。
zh_hant: 剪輯影片是一件很有創意的事情。

text: I think I'm creative.
What about you?
Yeah, I think especially
when you talk about what we do for work.
We invent new ideas and write scripts,
zh: 我们构思新点子并撰写剧本,
zh_hant: 我們構思新點子並撰寫劇本,

text: and that is quite inventive.
But what about outside of work?
That's what I was going to say.
Yes.
Outside of work.
I don't have any hobbies that are creative ,
zh: 我没有什么有创造性的爱好。
zh_hant: 我沒有什麼有創造性的愛好。

text: but when I was at school, I used to do photography
zh: 但我上学的时候,经常玩摄影。
zh_hant: 但我上學的時候,經常玩攝影。

text: as a class,
and that was quite creative .
You have to have a good eye when you,
zh: 挑东西的时候得有眼光才行
zh_hant: 挑東西的時候得有眼光才行

text: when you do photography.
But nowadays I don't do much, actually,
zh: 不过说实话,我现在不怎么做这个了。
zh_hant: 不過說實話,我現在不怎麼做這個了。

text: sometimes I like colouring in with those colouring books.
zh: 有时候我喜欢用那种涂色书涂色。
zh_hant: 有時候我喜歡用那種塗色書塗色。

text: I enjoy that,
but I also think you're not really creating much.
zh: 但我也觉得你其实没创造多少东西。
zh_hant: 但我也覺得你其實沒創造多少東西。

text: You're just choosing the colours.
Yeah, you almost need to draw the picture and then colour it in yourself.
zh: 你几乎得自己把图画出来,再自己上色。
zh_hant: 你幾乎得自己把圖畫出來,再自己上色。

text: Yeah, maybe I'll do that.
Maybe I'll try that.
What about you?
Outside of work?
I think
I was probably more creative when I was younger.
zh: 我年轻的时候可能更有创造力。
zh_hant: 我年輕的時候可能更有創造力。

text: Although, one of my friends at the moment is pregnant,
zh: 不过,我有一个朋友现在怀孕了
zh_hant: 不過,我有一個朋友現在懷孕了

text: so I have been making a blanket
for her baby.
It's a patchwork quilt,
so that means there's different squares of fabric,
zh: 所以这意味着有不同的方块布料,
zh_hant: 所以這意味著有不同的方塊布料,

text: and I've been cutting them out and sewing them together with my sewing machine.
zh: 我一直在把它们剪出来,然后用缝纫机把它们缝在一起。
zh_hant: 我一直在把它們剪出來,然後用縫紉機把它們縫在一起。

text: Wow.
What, what colours are in your patchwork quilt?
zh: 你的拼布被子上有什么颜色?
zh_hant: 你的拼布被子上有什麼顏色?

text: Well, they're, they're kind of blues
zh: 他们的音乐有点像蓝调
zh_hant: 他們的音樂有點像藍調

text: and whites and orange-y.
Because she doesn't know
if it's going
to be a boy or a girl.
And they're all a little bit patterned, so, yeah.
zh: 而且它们都带点儿花纹,所以,嗯,就是这样。
zh_hant: 而且它們都帶點兒花紋,所以,嗯,就是這樣。

text: So I've been making that so recently, I have been creative .
zh: 最近我经常做这个,所以我一直很有创意。
zh_hant: 最近我經常做這個,所以我一直很有創意。

text: Nice.
And, Beth, are there any creative things, hobbies you'd like to try?
zh: Beth,你有没有什么想尝试的创意活动或爱好?
zh_hant: Beth,你有沒有什麼想嘗試的創意活動或愛好?

text: Actually, I know someone
who does ceramics ,
so they make pots and mugs and plates
zh: 他们制作陶罐、杯子和盘子
zh_hant: 他們製作陶罐、杯子和盤子

text: and he does classes.
So, I'd quite like to take up
ceramics
or something like that,
just to give it a try.
That's a really good idea,
because then you can have new things to have in your kitchen,
zh: 这样你的厨房里就可以有新东西了。
zh_hant: 這樣你的廚房裡就可以有新東西了。

text: things that you can actually use.
Exactly.
Yeah.
And again, it's something I did as a child for fun,
zh: 这也是我小时候为了好玩而做的事情
zh_hant: 這也是我小時候為了好玩而做的事情

text: but I wouldn't really think about doing it now.
zh: 不过我现在不会真的考虑去做这件事。
zh_hant: 不過我現在不會真的考慮去做這件事。

text: But if I, like, took it up as a hobby,
zh: 如果我把这个当成一个爱好来做的话
zh_hant: 如果我把這個當成一個愛好來做的話

text: then it's something creative to do.
zh: 那就是一件有创意的事情。
zh_hant: 那就是一件有創意的事情。

text: Yeah.
Nice to do with your hands.
What about you?
I don't have any ideas at the moment, but I would like to spend my free time doing something creative because
zh: 我目前没有什么想法,但我想利用空闲时间做一些有创意的事情,因为
zh_hant: 我目前沒有什麼想法,但我想利用空閒時間做一些有創意的事情,因為

text: I think it's quite therapeutic.
It's a good way to take your mind off the stresses of life.
zh: 这是一个让你从生活压力中解脱出来的好方法。
zh_hant: 這是一個讓你從生活壓力中解脫出來的好方法。

text: So, yeah, no ideas yet.
But watch this space.
We also
had sewing ,
which is when you make things from material like
zh: 比如说用材料制作东西的时候
zh_hant: 比如說用材料製作東西的時候

text: clothes or blankets.
We also had ceramics , which is also called pottery,
zh: 我们还上过陶艺课,也叫制陶。
zh_hant: 我們還上過陶藝課,也叫製陶。

text: which is when you make things like bowls and plates
zh: 就是制作碗、盘子这类东西的时候
zh_hant: 就是製作碗、盤子這類東西的時候

text: out of a material called clay.
zh: 用一种叫做粘土的材料制成的
zh_hant: 用一種叫做粘土的材料製成的

text: And if you take up a hobby, you start doing it for the first time.
zh: 如果你培养一个爱好,你就开始第一次尝试做这件事。
zh_hant: 如果你培養一個愛好,你就開始第一次嘗試做這件事。

text: And that's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 《Real Easy English》这期节目就到这里。
zh_hant: 《Real Easy English》這期節目就到這裡。

text: Remember, you can test what you've learnt using the worksheet
zh: 别忘了,你可以用练习册来检验你学到的内容。
zh_hant: 別忘了,你可以用練習冊來檢驗你學到的內容。

text: on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
And next time we'll be talking about secrets.
See you then.
Bye.
